item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a cell, a lamp, and a switch S. The switch is open, so its contacts do not touch.

Is the circuit ON or OFF?

options.A: OFF — the open switch breaks the path, so current cannot flow.
options.B: ON — the cell still sends current across the open gap.
options.C: ON — the switch itself supplies current to the lamp.
options.D: OFF — a lamp cannot glow unless two switches are used.
